course_review/1.card_source: golfify (golfify.io/courses/swope-memorial-golf-course), fetched 2026-10-30; AllSquare (meters) and OpenGolfAPI agree hole for hole; club site has no scorecard page (2026 PDF unreadable via web fetch), GolfLink 403, BlueGolf 405
course_notes: Front-nine numbering mismatch: OSM's golf=hole refs 3-9 follow a different order than every card source (OSM pars 4 4 4 3 5 5 3 4 4 vs card 4 4 4 4 5 3 4 3 5). Both orders chain green-to-tee, but the card's (OSM 1,2,8,9,6,7,3,4,5) is the one golfify, AllSquare and OpenGolfAPI publish. The build put card holes 3-9 on the wrong OSM ways: par 4s on a par-3 line (4), a par 3 on a par-5 line (6), tees walked back into the woods (4, 6).
Holes 1, 2 and 10-18 are right: routing, green, par and Blue/White tees on OSM boxes within 1-7 yds of the card.

Renovation: the course was closed Jan 2025 - Jul 2026 (new tees, greens, bunkers, a new pond; kcparks.org). The card and NAIP 2020 imagery predate it, so yardages and hazards may have changed; check the 2026 club card (swopememorialgolfcourse.com/docs/Scorecard-2026.pdf) before publishing.
